data.name: Baqarah
data.gender_notes: Baqarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Quran, Surah Al-Baqarah is the second surah and the longest surah in the Quran. The name comes from the Arabic word 'baqarah' meaning 'cow'. The name Baqarah carries the meaning “Cow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baqarah usually hope their child will grow to embody cow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rich in Islamic symbolism, representing submission, obedience, and nurturing, like a mother cow taking care of her calf.
data.etymology: Baqarah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Cow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baqarah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
